CRL.M.C. 2274/2026, CRL.M.A. 9292/2026 (stay) & CRL.M.A. 9293/2026 (for interim relief/directions)
3.
Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 64/2026 of PS Economic Offences Wing, Delhi for offence under Section 120B read with Section 420 IPC on merits.

4. Learned Senior Counsel for petitioners in his preliminary submissions submits that the Directorate of Enforcement has no power to get the FIR registered, especially in a case where the creditors, who allegedly suffered loss have not made any complaint.

Secondly, learned Senior Counsel for petitioners also contends that according to legal position the CIRP once completed,
cannot be reopened and it is alleged by petitioners that this is being done at behest of two other business entities.
Further, it is contended that the FIR fails to make out any cognizable offence.

5. Learned APP for respondent no. 1 and learned counsel for respondent no. 2 accept notice.
Learned counsel for respondent no. 2 Directorate of Enforcement points out that the subject FIR is hardly few days old and investigation is at initial stage.
It is also submitted that the Directorate of Enforcement has already filed application for recall of the resolution process, though notice is yet to be issued.
6. Status report be filed within four weeks.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 27/03/2026 at 22:55:18 7.
Learned Senior Counsel for petitioners submits that till next date, investigation be stayed.
But keeping in mind the above circumstances, especially the nascent stage of the investigation, I am not inclined to stay investigation without hearing both sides at length.

8. However, as regards the request of learned Senior Counsel for protection from arrest, it is made clear that if the petitioners are advised to file appropriate proceedings, pendency of this petition shall not be an obstacle.
9. Relist on 14.05.2026 in Advance List.
GIRISH KATHPALIA, J MARCH 27, 2026 'rs'
